review_locator: PMCID:PMC4488900, Role of group 3 innate lymphoid cells in antibody production; PMCID:PMC4005806, Innate lymphoid cells integrate stromal and immunological signals to enhance antibody production by splenic marginal zone B cells
primary_title: Innate lymphoid cells integrate stromal and immune signals to enhance antibody production by splenic marginal zone B cells
decision_basis: The review identifies the Magri primary showing that human splenic ROR-gamma-t-positive ILCs express surface and soluble BAFF and stimulate IgM secretion by marginal-zone B cells; BAFF-R-Ig attenuates the ILC-induced response.
limitations_preserved: Mediator-supported functional bridge; preserve surface/soluble BAFF and human splenic ILC-to-MZ-B-cell contact context, treat BAFF-R-Ig attenuation as contribution rather than sole necessity, and do not infer a transcript-to-protein step, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effect.
